Kotatsu-Redo yezmer tura ad d-yessken iwenniten d yizalen seg yimeɣriyen nniḍen, syen ad iseqdec ayen iwala kul yiwen akken ad d-yessers iɣbula i yeddu akken ilaq deg uqerru n inadiyen-ik.\n\nUlac amiḍan. Ulac imayl, ulac taggalt. Agdil-ik yessnulfu taggalt tuzrift, d netta tamagit-ik meṛṛa — tzemmred ad t-teskelsed syen ad t-tesemtiḍ ɣer tiliɣri tamaynut.

Ur yezmir ara ad yawweḍ ɣer uqddac. Arm ticki.

Mi yexṣer uɣbalu, neɣ yewweḍ ɣer lweqt, neɣ ur d-yerr walu, asnas-ik yezmer ad t-id-yini — akken ad d-yessers urzzu n kul yiwen iɣbula i yeddu akken ilaq deg uqerru.\n\nAseqsi yini kan: anwa aɣbalu, ma yedda, d wamek i ɣḍa. Werjin yegber azwel n manga, urzzu i tsekced, neɣ tasna i teldid. Asulay yettbeddal yal ass.
